environment: Local production build, synthetic administrator/member accounts, Chrome desktop and 390x844 mobile viewport
authority: Native Matrix m.room.name with the existing SQL binding label projection; product changes serialize under the membership lock

runtimeCoverage: Verified native state and unchanged room identity, epoch and messages
Remote participant sync and name search
Repeated desired name, stale expected name and concurrent edits
Native write failure leaves the SQL name unchanged and retry succeeds
Member, wrong workspace and absent session writes denied

limits: Matrix and SQL do not share a distributed transaction; uncertain outcomes can require retry
No compare-and-set guarantee against external Matrix clients
Remote name changes use existing authorized history recovery
Additional creator work deferred at the user's request
